description: This Java class implements an immutable command to delete a feature property in a live editing context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract modify command and provides methods to retrieve command details, set headers, and create answer builders.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: Immutable implementation class for DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommand, providing behavior to delete feature properties on the fly.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl from a generic Command, casting it to DeleteFeatureProperty.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature to be deleted.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the specific property to delete.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization; returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for creating responses to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object, including class name and superclass info.
